name: Kit

intro.text: {player}! Over here! Smile, you're on camera!
I got here first, so I got a bit of training in. A LOT of training.
Let's go. And try to lose in a way that looks good on video!

win: Noooo. That was going to be my best clip!
after: Fine, you're better than me. I'm still going viral, mind.
